initial_review.adjudication: The January 9 police notice announced a January 11–12 election closure. SRTB's January 10 report attributes a superseding decision to the Government Secretary-General: borders would remain open for the January 11 vote. The planned window was cancelled before it began. Preserve the original order as historical evidence, remove its active chronology phase and exclude this parent from closure-analysis counts. This does not assert that unrelated pre-existing restrictions at individual frontiers ended.
